text:
91. The Council has a standing Communications Committee which keeps this area of
its work under constant review, and it is always open to considering new initiatives
which will enhance public understanding of the operation of sentencing in
Scotland. In addition, that Committee is overseeing an extensive publicity exercise
which will accompany launch of the guideline, once it has been approved by the
High Court. Where respondents have made suggestions about how to enhance
public understanding of the sentencing process and the guideline, these will be
considered as part of this work, even where they have not led to changes to the
guideline itself.
